title: Issuance of identification card.
bodyText: The issuing agency shall issue one identification card at the same time it issues a disability parking permit to a person with a disability.
bodyHtml: §291-52.5  Issuance of identification card.  The issuing agency shall issue one identification card at the same time it issues a disability parking permit to a person with a disability. [L 2001, c 297, pt of §1; am L 2003, c 30, §5; am L 2010, c 141, §6; am L 2019, c 87, §6]
